question: Should workflow completion integrations use the existing typed plugin `agent_end` and `session_end` hooks, or should operator-installed internal hooks gain a new completion event with separately defined semantics?
rationale: Both hook systems are established, but they serve different ownership and typing boundaries; source inspection cannot determine whether duplicating lifecycle signals into internal hooks is intentional product direction.

options.title: Standardize on plugin hooks
options.body: Document `agent_end` for completed work and `session_end` for session retirement as the supported workflow-orchestration contracts, and remove the unrelated closing reference from the rollover PR.

options.title: Add a distinct internal event
options.body: Define whether it represents run completion or session retirement, then wire every applicable gateway, cron, subagent, error, and reset path with ordering and deduplication tests.

recommendation.title: Standardize on plugin hooks
recommendation.body: Document `agent_end` for completed work and `session_end` for session retirement as the supported workflow-orchestration contracts, and remove the unrelated closing reference from the rollover PR.
